status: QUEUE ENTRY — a proposal and a census. Registers nothing, routes nothing, no lane reads it.
whyQueued: #2174 pins these rows on the bare `fleer` key until a checklist exists. The post-wave audit found the same shape by hand: '2002 Fleer Greats of the Game Kirby Puckett / Don Mattingly Dueling Duos #6 DD' stored AND derived as baseball:2002:fleer:6:Base:no-auto, with the named product and the named insert both lost. A checklist is what unpins them.

poolCensus.method: sold_comps rows whose TITLE contains 'greats of the game', read-only 2026-09-15, paged; no cross-partition COUNT.
poolCensus.note: The football|2026|topps-flagship (260) and basketball|2009|upper-deck (69) cells are DIFFERENT products whose titles happen to contain the phrase. They are not this acquisition and must not be swept in.

yearsAndSources.brand: Sports Illustrated Greats of the Game
yearsAndSources.manufacturerNote: Fleer made it under a Sports Illustrated licence. The SI partnership ended after this year.
yearsAndSources.keyNote: DO NOT key 1999 as Fleer. The pool already agrees: 378 rows sit on `sports-illustrated-greats-of-the-game` and 68 on a long-form variant, against only 86 on bare `fleer`.
yearsAndSources.autographs: Autographs, 80 on-card, 1:7 packs (three Reggie Jackson variations) — its own key.
Autographs, 93 cards, 1:6 packs, some short-printed; plus Memorable Moments autographed parallels.
Autographs, 94 cards — an explicit PARTIAL PARALLEL OF THE BASE SET, so it shares card numbers with base and WILL merge into the base pool on a number-only match. Highest-risk year.
Autographs, 69 cards; plus Dueling Duos Autographs — the insert the audit's Puckett/Mattingly row names.

yearsAndSources.evidence: https://baseballcardpedia.com/index.php/2003_Greats_of_the_Game returns HTTP 404 — a measured absence, not an absent search hit.

yearsAndSources.structureNote: Cards 1-80 shipped in June as the regular product; 81-145 shipped in December as the Greats of the Game CUT SIGNATURE EDITION — a differently-boxed product under a different name, despite continuous numbering. Whether that is one setKey or two is a ruling; the checklist parses as one 145-row list either way.
yearsAndSources.autographs: Autographs in both series, plus Battery Mates, Yankees Clippings, Announcing Greats Dual, and three cut-signature sets.

yearsAndSources.evidence: https://baseballcardpedia.com/index.php/2005_Greats_of_the_Game returns HTTP 404. Fleer went bankrupt in 2005, which is the likely reason there is no release.

yearsAndSources.manufacturerNote: UPPER DECK, not Fleer — the first edition of the brand after Fleer's bankruptcy; Upper Deck bought Fleer out of bankruptcy in 2005.
yearsAndSources.autographs: Base Autographs, 100 cards — a full 1:1 parallel of the 100-card base, so it shares every card number with base. Second-highest-risk year after 2001.

openConflict.what: Who made 2006 Greats of the Game.
openConflict.baseballcardpediaSays: Upper Deck, and gives a sourced reason (released 2006-04-10, the first Greats edition after Fleer's bankruptcy).
openConflict.sportscardchecklistSays: https://www.sportscardchecklist.com/set-91159/2006-fleer-greats-of-the-game-baseball-trading-card-checklist labels it 'Fleer'. That page was NOT fetched, so this is a title-level conflict, not a verified one.
openConflict.ourPoolSays: 52 rows sit on baseball|2006|fleer — which is evidence of how sellers spell it, not of who made it.
openConflict.question: If the setKey namespace carries a manufacturer token, 2006 must not inherit `fleer` on baseballcardpedia's account. RESOLVE BEFORE COMMITTING A KEY.

rulingsNeeded: 1999 keys as `sports-illustrated-greats-of-the-game`, not Fleer — yes/no? (The pool already spells it that way on 446 of its 532 rows.)
2006 keys as Upper Deck, not Fleer — yes/no? (See openConflict.)
2004's cards 81-145 (Cut Signature Edition) — one setKey with the base, or its own?

The autograph sets get their own keys in every year — yes/no? 1,437 of the 4,477 pool rows name an auto or signature, and in 2001 and 2006 the autograph set shares card numbers with base, so a number-only match silently merges them.

estimatedRows.note: 90 + 107 + 137 + 100 + 145 + 100 across the six years that exist. Autograph and insert sets are extra and are not counted here because their keys are unruled.
